description: Computation of g_A from the Borromean Skein algebra. The axial coupling is the ratio of antisymmetric to symmetric Markov traces on the Borromean link B_3 at q = 1.110.
status: OPEN — requires colored Jones polynomial computation
computation_plan: 1. Represent Borromean link β in Hecke algebra H_6(q)
2. Compute fundamental Markov trace tr_fund(β) — vector channel
3. Compute adjoint Markov trace tr_adj(β) — axial channel
Alternative: Use Sage QuantumKnotInvariants for colored Jones
required_tools: OR: Direct Hecke algebra computation in H_6(q)
